drivingQuestion: From where does R. Eliezer derive that the facilitators of circumcision override Shabbat?
outcomeNote: derived from ביום השמיני; circumcision cannot be the sole paradigm because of its thirteen covenants

segments.he: אָמַר מָר: מִילָה וְכׇל מַכְשִׁירֶיהָ דּוֹחִין אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר. מְנָא לֵיהּ לְרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר הָא? אִי מִכּוּלְּהוּ גָּמַר — כִּדְאָמְרִינַן. וְעוֹד: מָה לְהָנָךְ
segments.en: Earlier it was taught that «the Master said» in the baraita: The mitzva of «circumcision and all its facilitators override Shabbat;» this is «the statement of Rabbi Eliezer.» The Gemara asks: «From where does Rabbi Eliezer» derive «this» halakha? «If he derives it from all of» the other mitzvot cited above, we can refute it, «as we have» already «said» that each one of them includes a unique aspect of severity or significance. «And furthermore,» there is another difficulty: «What» is unique about «these» mitzvot

segments.he: שֶׁכֵּן אִם עָבַר זְמַנָּהּ בָּטְלָה. אֶלָּא הַיְינוּ טַעְמָא דְּרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר, דְּאָמַר קְרָא: ״וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי יִמּוֹל בְּשַׂר עׇרְלָתוֹ״, וַאֲפִילּוּ בְּשַׁבָּת.
segments.en: in each, «as if its time passed, it is void,» unlike the mitzva of circumcision, which can be fulfilled at a later date if the child is not circumcised on the eighth day. «Rather, this is the reason» for the opinion «of Rabbi Eliezer, as the verse says: “And on the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised”» (Leviticus 12:3), indicating that he is circumcised on the eighth day «even» if it falls «on Shabbat.»

segments.he: וְלִיכְתּוֹב רַחֲמָנָא בְּמִילָה, וְלֵיתוֹ הָנָךְ וְלִיגְמְרוּ מִינֵּיהּ! מִשּׁוּם דְּאִיכָּא לְמִיפְרַךְ: מָה לְמִילָה שֶׁכֵּן נִכְרְתוּ עָלֶיהָ שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה בְּרִיתוֹת.
segments.en: The Gemara asks: «And let the Torah write» this principle only «with regard to» the mitzva of «circumcision, and let these» other mitzvot «come and derive» their halakhot «from it.» The Gemara answers: «Because» this suggestion «can be refuted: What» is unique about the mitzva of «circumcision? That thirteen covenants were established over it,» as the word covenant is mentioned thirteen times in the passage dealing with the circumcision of Abraham (Genesis 17). Owing to its great significance, other mitzvot cannot be derived from it.
